english.title: Aquaculture production business operator failing to provide eel catch records to agency / allow inspection
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an aquaculture production business operator, failed to

(A)_[provide to **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..), the appropriate agency, a copy of the record required under regulation 4(1) of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009 at such intervals as the agency had specified]_
(B)_[allow **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..), the appropriate agency, to inspect the record required under regulation 4(1) of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009 at a reasonable time]_
(C)_[provide to **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..), the appropriate agency, a copy of the record required under regulation 4(1) of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009 at such intervals as the agency had specified and allow that agency to inspect that record at a reasonable time]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 4(2), (3) and 28(1) of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
aquaculture production business operator
failed to provide Environment Agency with copy of r.4 record
at intervals specified by Agency OR
failed to allow Agency to inspect record
